description: This file contains integration tests for the ReadingGoalController in the Book Project, verifying REST API endpoints related to reading goals, user login, and request handling.

classes.name: ReadingGoalControllerIntegrationTest
classes.description: JUnit integration test class for verifying REST endpoints of ReadingGoalController, including setup method for user login and multiple test cases for goal management.

methods.name: canLoginWithTestUser
methods.description: Sets up a test user and retrieves JWT token for authenticated requests.

methods.name: getPreviousReadingGoals_returnHttpStatus_whenReadingGoalExists
methods.description: Tests the GET endpoint for retrieving previous reading goals, expects HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: addBooksReadingGoal_returnBadRequestHttpStatus_whenWrongTargetInput
methods.description: Tests creating a reading goal with invalid target (zero), expects HTTP 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: addPagesReadingGoal_returnBadRequestHttpStatus_whenWrongTargetInput
methods.description: Tests creating a pages reading goal with invalid target, expects HTTP 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: addBooksReadingGoal_returnIsOkRequestHttpStatus_whenCorrectTargetInput
methods.description: Tests creating a books reading goal with valid target, expects HTTP 201 Created.

methods.name: addPagesReadingGoal_returnIsOkRequestHttpStatus_whenCorrectTargetInput
methods.description: Tests creating a pages reading goal with valid target, expects HTTP 201 Created.

methods.name: deleteReadingGoal_returnIsOkRequestHttpStatus_whenRequestIsDone
methods.description: Tests deleting the reading goal, expects HTTP 204 No Content.
